assignments.node_text: לוֹמֵד בִּקְדֻשָּׁה וּבְטָהֳרָה אֵיזֶה דִּין וּפְסָק שֶׁחִדֵּשׁ אֵיזֶה תַּנָּא — studying Torah in holiness and purity
connected_to: מביא את רוח התנא לתוך התורה שלומד עכשו
assignments.reason: In this Torah, 'תורה' as the cause-node in all eitza edges refers specifically to the act of learning Torah she-be'al peh — studying the halakhot and chiddushim of the Tannaim in holiness and purity. The source text (section א, lines 7-8) states: 'וּכְשֶׁהָאָדָם לוֹמֵד בִּקְדֻשָּׁה וּבְטָהֳרָה אֵיזֶה דִּין וּפְסָק' — learning a ruling or halakha that a Tanna innovated. This is not Torah in a generic sense; it is the specific act of engaging with תורה שבעל פה. The entire Torah #12 is built around the drama of Oral Torah — who studies it, how it is studied, and what spiritual unions result. The node's essential nature is the active engagement with Oral Torah, which IS the defining reality of Package 2. Package 2 already contains תורה שבעל פה, רחל (the Oral Torah as Rachel before her shearers), דוד (Tehilla leDavid = the Oral Torah in its mixed/fallen state), and יין (wine = malkhut rav = Oral Torah). The act of learning Torah is the human engagement with this same Oral Torah reality.

assignments.node_id: מביא את רוח התנא לתוך התורה שלומד עכשו
assignments.node_text: שֶׁמֵּבִיא אֶת רוּחַ הַתַּנָּא לְתוֹךְ הַתּוֹרָה שֶׁלּוֹמֵד עַכְשָׁו — brings the Tanna's spirit into the Torah being studied
assignments.reason: Bringing the Tanna's spirit into the Torah being studied now is the EFFECT of neshikin — the result of the spiritual kiss. The source text (section ג, line 21) states: 'וַיְבִיאֵהוּ אֶל בֵּיתוֹ — שֶׁמֵּבִיא אֶת רוּחַ הַתַּנָּא לְתוֹךְ הַתּוֹרָה שֶׁלּוֹמֵד עַכְשָׁו, כִּי שָׁם בֵּיתוֹ'. This is the completion of the neshikin process: first comes the kiss (התדבקות רוחא ברוחא), then the Tanna's spirit is brought 'home' — into the Torah being learned. Its essential nature is the dwelling of the Tanna's spirit through the spiritual-kiss union. Package 1 already contains נשיקין (the kiss itself), התדבקות רוחא ברוחא (the union of spirit with spirit), and 'שפתותיו שושנים' (the lips that kiss). This node is the culmination of that same neshikin reality — the spirit-to-spirit bond taking residence in the Torah. It is not Torah-study (Package 2) but rather the spiritual-union dimension (Package 1) that results from proper study.
